name: teamcity-axi
description: Bounded read-only TeamCity evidence for coding agents

scripts.format: eslint src --fix && prettier --write src bin scripts tests schemas examples package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json eslint.config.mjs .github
scripts.format:check: eslint src --max-warnings 0 && prettier --check src bin scripts tests schemas examples package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json eslint.config.mjs .github
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/executable-contract/*.test.mjs
